title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1493: Kill an invincible (1)

section.p: How many of them were prepared to die?
Nobody knew.
They only knew that a death sovereign had just spawned beside Great Qin King. The death sovereign was still confused when a spear swept over and sent him flying.
Great Qin King said, “Death spirits, you need to wait until I’m done killing if you want to come after me.”

After the death sovereign was sent near the edge of Devote King’s residence, he stopped moving. But he was still confused. Where was this? Right, this was the Luminous Domain Mansion. The heavenly laws had transfered him here. More importantly, where were the original death sovereigns here?
When he turned his head…dang! A bunch of death sovereigns were looking at him from outside the residence.

Tuofa, who was finding the newly arrived death sovereign familiar, sent a voice transmission, “Wait. Let them fight. That’s Great Qin King. Deal with him after he’s done fighting. He will kill you if you interfere now.”
Once again, the newly arrived death sovereign blanked out. He looked at Great Qin King and the other Invincibles.
Holy shit!
Why were there so many Invincibles here? Also, wasn’t that…Great Qin King of the human race? Yes. Even those in the Death Realm were familiar with the current leader of humanity.
Great Qin King, Qin Guang, an incomparably powerful expert.

More importantly, how did Tuofa and the others leave the residence? The newly arrived death sovereign was too confused. He had only one goal here: to kill Great Qin King. That was what the heavenly laws required of him. But he also knew that he couldn’t do it. He would fail, allowing the heavenly laws to bring an even stronger death sovereign here. However, Great Qin King had sent him flying.

Looking at the Invincibles near Great Qin King, the death sovereign finally understood something. Death spirits weren’t completely stupid. He could see that these Invincibles were going to start fighting soon.
Very good. With a few more deaths, more death sovereigns would arrive. Together, they could kill Great Qin King. Yes. That would be the best plan.

He was curious about the death sovereigns outside the residence, but he wasn’t interested in asking too much. He was still too busy feeling excited for his presence here. He had never been in the Luminous Domain Mansion before.
Ultimately, he decided to slow down and look around for now. After all, this was a new place for him.
Amid the crowd.
Blood Fire Devil King and Lightning Divine King revealed themselves. With seven devil kings and five divine kings present, there were twelve of them in total.
Behind them, two dragon kings arrived.
The celestial chasm Invincible had arrived.
The nether Invincible had arrived as well.
Sixteen Invincibles.
The phoenix, fate, five elemental, and Heavenly Hunt Pavilion Invincibles stood even further away. They were observing solemnly instead of joining the battle.
Was a ninth-degree Eternal powerful? Yes. Very powerful. That was especially true for Great Qin King, someone on the verge of achieving Daofuse.

However, he was being surrounded by sixteen Invincibles, including one ninth-degree Eternal, two seventh-degree Eternals, and other Eternals among them. Almost all of these people were beyond the middle degree.
Great Qin King was strong enough to fight, three, five, or even eight of them at a time. He was Great Qin King. Not even Blood Fire Divine King could defeat Great Qin King.

But because he was Great Qin King, he was faced with a far higher number of Invincibles. There was no hesitation. Not even Su Yu could lure them away anymore. Because this was Great Qin King. This was the guardian of humanity. Killing him would set the stage for another human defeat.

It didn’t matter how strong Great Zhou King and Great Xia King were. Compared to Great Qin King, they were lacking. Sure, Great Qin King wasn’t that much stronger than them, but humanity needed his personal charm. He was someone who had guarded the Eastrift Valley alone for four hundred years. He and his spear against the myriad races.
That was the source of his personal charm.

As for the other human Invincibles, they would only rotate in and out of the Allheaven Battlefield. Most of them would remain in seclusion and cultivation even while they were guarding the front lines. However, Great Qin King was an exception. He had never left the Allheaven Battlefield. From the day the Human Realm was connected to the Allheaven Battlefield, he had been guarding humanity against the myriad races.
Four hundred years. Day after day. His protection had allowed humanity to reverse its decline and emerge as one of the top races among the myriad races.
He was not an Emperor.
He was merely an Eternal capable of suppressing all the other human Eternals.

Lightning Divine King shouted, “Great Qin King of the human race has entered the mansion. Is everyone going to keep watching? Are you waiting for Great Qin King to become a Pseudo Emperor and eliminate the myriad races? When a human achieves Daofuse, who can challenge him? He can attack the various realms freely. No suppressive force can stop him.”
Nobody had expected to see Great Qin King here. The human race was too bold. Bold yet rash. The risk was too high.

“Heaven Department head, what does the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion think of this? Do you think you stand a chance with Great Qin King here? The skylotus will be his. There is only hope if we join hands and eliminate him.”
The Heaven Department head did not react. This wasn’t an easy decision to make. The human race was acknowledged as the public enemy.
Nobody wanted to see them produce a Pseudo Emperor. The moment Great Qin King became a Daofuse, he would be able to remain undefeated even when invading other realms.
At present, the various Pseudo Emperors still had the confidence of defending against Great Qin King even when he was invading them. In fact, that would be their best opportunity to kill him.
The celestial chasm and nether races did not have much hesitation about this, but the five elemental, fate, and a few other races hesitated.
Great Qin King watched silently.
He was waiting for the result of the battle between the humans and immortals. Finally, a divine king decided to help the immortals. It was then that a massive explosion erupted.
It was deafening.
A spear shot out, shaking the entire world.
“Kill!”

Boundless killing intent soared into the sky. The divine, devil, dragon, and nether kings acted together. If they did not eliminate Great Qin King here, all of them would die. Since Great Qin King had revealed himself here, peace was no longer possible.

As a gigantic spear swept through the area, an Invincible said, “Five elementals, you can ignore Great Qin King, but attack the other humans. Otherwise, the five elemental race will also be declared the public enemy of the myriad races after this.”

“Don’t even dream of safety in the event of our deaths. I have already notified those outside by igniting my own blood essence. Everyone is aware that Great Qin King is here. If Great Qin King survives with the rest of you…the divines, devils, immortals, dragons, and nethers will wipe you out.”

The five elemental and fate Invincibles blanked out slightly. They were still struggling to make a decision. If those outside were already aware of this, it wouldn’t matter even if they were to help the humans and eliminate these people. They would be in big trouble after leaving the mansion.

Could the people inside the mansion contact those outside? Yes. The simplest method was through the ignition of their blood essence. This had been done before. Was someone doing that now? Nobody knew. Perhaps this was an empty threat. Perhaps this was true. But it was working. They started wavering.

In truth, there wasn’t even a need for them to join the fight. The sixteen Invincibles involved in the battle against Great Qin King were already strong enough to finish the job. Alone, not even Blood Fire Devil King could defeat Great Qin King.
But Great Qin King couldn’t defeat sixteen of them. If he was strong enough to defeat all sixteen of them alone, humanity would have broken free of their suppression by the myriad races long ago.
Great Qin King continued swinging his spear without saying anything.
“Kill!”

Great Qin King knew that this wasn’t the time for him to take it slow. He had to attack with all the ferocity he could muster. He must plant fear and awe in their minds. That was his sole path of survival.

He was surprisingly decisive. While allowing the attacks of Blood Fire Devil King and Lightning Divine King to land on him, he swept his spear out, breaking a River of Time before bringing the spear back and stabbing through a devil king.

The devil king exploded before regenerating with one less body. Fear covered his face. As for Great Qin King, he groaned and took on more attacks before sending his spear out with a roar. Once again, he destroyed a tri-life body of the same devil king. Then, he charged forth and sent a divine king flying with a punch before arriving before the same devil king. With yet another roar, he grabbed the devil king with both hands and ripped the devil king apart.
Blood rained down from the sky.
Thick crimson clouds gathered in the sky.

The entire world rumbled, signifying the death of the second Invincible in Great Qin King’s hands. The back of Great Qin King was already thoroughly charred due to the attacks of Lightning Divine King. His entire arm was bruised and bloodied, thanks to the attack from Blood Fire Devil King that had nearly chopped his arm off.
He was also carrying various other wounds on his body. He was fighting with his life on the line right from the start.

He was the mighty Great Qin King, but he was no Daofuse. He wouldn’t be unrivaled even if he was a Daofuse. As a mere ninth-degree Eternal, he had killed two Invincibles instantly even when he was facing a superior number of Invincibles.
“How many of you are prepared to die today?”
He repeated his question, his voice slamming into the minds of his opponents. Fear flickered on the faces of his opponents, but they braced themselves and roared madly before charging him again.

They might die facing him. But they might also die not facing him. Just by showing up here, Great Qin King had turned this into a battle to the death. There was no other alternative. The deaths of two Invincibles only served to convince them the importance of killing Great Qin King.

Meanwhile, the humans were finally occupying the upper hand. Xia Longwu and the others were attacking madly. They were anxious. They were afraid that Great Qin King would be in trouble even if they could win here.

The three immortal kings resisted the attacks coldly and calmly. Suddenly, they roared and started shining brightly. At that, their strength increased rapidly. They had all ignited their blood essence.

They knew that they would not receive any help here. Great Qin King was the main target of all the other Invincibles. They only needed to last longer. Victory would be theirs after Great Qin King was defeated. They only needed to keep the human Invincibles busy.

The three immortal kings had joined hands to face the four human Invincibles. Not one of the human Invincibles could break free as the three immortal kings were doing their best to keep the human Invincibles occupied.

Xing Yue, who was leading several death sovereigns, was just about to interfere when the Heaven Department head appeared before her with a sigh. “Since the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion is staying out of this, I suggest the death spirits do the same.”
Furious, Xing Yue roared, “Kill!”
They attacked together, but the Heaven Department head was able to handle them without much difficulty.

In terms of cultivation level alone, him, Great Qin King, and Blood Fire Devil King were similar. Thus, he was more than enough to handle four death sovereigns. As for Great Qin King, a new death sovereign had appeared nearby.

This time, he wasn’t given the chance to send the death sovereign flying. While the death sovereign was still confused, the previous death sovereign flew over and updated him. Then, the two death sovereigns moved away and focused on Great Qin King instead of attacking any other Invincibles.

They had been instructed by the heavenly laws to kill Great Qin King. Thus, they were waiting for an opportunity to do so. It would not matter even if Great Qin King had the strength to kill sixteen Invincibles as that would only be replaced by sixteen death sovereigns ordered to kill him.
This was a bitter battle.
A bloodied spear kept sweeping through the area.

With his hair whipping about wildly and his bloodied body, Great Qin King swung his spear yet again, shattering space and destroying the tri-life body of a divine king. The divine king retreated promptly, allowing someone else to take his place. In the blink of an eye, more wounds were left on Great Qin King’s body.
“Father!”
Qin Zhen’s mournful wail rang out in the air, but he was too weak to do anything. He couldn’t even break free from his current opponents.

After losing one body, his remaining bodies had been greatly injured. He was no longer capable of doing much against these Invincibles. With the three immortal kings fighting with all their strength, it wouldn’t be easy for the human Invincibles to break free.
After all, Invincibles were notoriously hard to kill, especially when the gap in strength wasn’t that big. As for Lan Tian, he was kept busy by Heavencurse of the celestial chasm race.
